question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **globally**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• **Globally**: In a way that relates to the whole world. (एक तरह से जो पूरी दुनिया से संबंधित है)
 
• **Tediously**: In a boring way that continues for a long time. (एक उबाऊ तरीके से जो लंबे समय तक चलता रहता है)
 
• **Industrially**: In factories, or in a way that is related to the industry. (कारखानों में, या एक तरह से जो उद्योग से संबंधित है)
 
• **Mutually**: Felt or done by two or more people or groups in the same way. (एक ही तरह से दो या दो से अधिक लोगों या समूहों द्वारा महसूस या किया गया)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "**globally**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: The industry is well-known across the world.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Complete passage:__ *India is one of the largest producers of tea in the world. The industry is **__(1) globally__** recognised as technically very well (2) __ __. The Indian tea industry is a (3) __ __ one traditionally. Tea has been used in India for (4) __ __ purposes as well as for (5) __ __.*

43:Te20,

The correct answer is: **equipped**.
